lessons.title: Civil claims and parties
lessons.description: Learn English used to describe civil claims and parties.
objectives: Identify parties in a civil case

vocabulary.example: The claimant filed a civil claim.
The civil claim concerns unpaid rent.

vocabulary.meaning: المستجيب أو المدعى عليه بحسب الإجراء

sections.heading: Courtroom example
sections.body: The claimant filed a civil claim. The defendant submitted a response. The court will review the documents and hear both parties.

sections.heading: Usage note
sections.body: Legal terms vary by jurisdiction. Respondent is common in some applications and appeals; defendant is common in many civil claims.

quiz.question: Who usually brings a civil claim?
quiz.explanation: The claimant brings the claim before the court.

quiz.question: Who is the defendant?
options: The party against whom a claim is brought
quiz.explanation: The defendant is the party against whom the claim is brought.

lessons.title: Settlement and negotiation
lessons.description: Discuss settlement proposals and terms in clear professional English.

vocabulary.example: The defendant made a settlement offer.
The agreement sets out the payment terms.
The parties want to resolve the dispute.

sections.heading: Negotiation dialogue
sections.body:
A: Our client is willing to consider a settlement.
B: Please send the proposed terms in writing.
A: We will review the offer and respond by Friday.

sections.heading: Usage note
sections.body: The legal effect of settlement communications depends on the applicable law. This lesson teaches language, not jurisdiction-specific legal advice.

quiz.question: What is a counteroffer?
quiz.explanation: A counteroffer proposes different or revised terms.

quiz.question: Which word means an unresolved disagreement?
quiz.explanation: A dispute is a disagreement between parties.
